image_description: A vintage black typewriter sitting on a wooden surface. It features a sheet of white paper with typed text inserted in the carriage. The keyboard consists of round, circular keys with characters printed on them, arranged in rows. The bottom row contains a long, rectangular key (the space bar) situated between two modifier keys.
